notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to any creature you control.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any creature except the one with Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
